title: NIH PAR-25-144 · cost criterion
scope: Only one sentence in Section V, Factor 1 of https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/pa-files/PAR-25-144.html was supplied. Other clauses and attachments were outside this review.

findings.question: Can a team tell whether its project qualifies, when to apply and what the award can cover?
findings.rationale: Outside the scope of this cost-criterion excerpt.

findings.question: Does the call show how communities and other funders shaped it and how related efforts can work together?
findings.rationale: Outside the scope of this cost-criterion excerpt.

findings.question: Which existing proposal sections will the funder accept, and which supplements affect this award?
findings.rationale: Outside the scope of this cost-criterion excerpt.

findings.question: Do allowable costs and award size support the reach, follow-up and maintenance requested?
findings.rationale: The criterion asks reviewers to consider costs. This passage gives them no way to compare planned reach with what the budget can support.
findings.quote: Evaluate whether consideration has been given to resource requirements and costs of the intervention

edit.anchor: Evaluate whether consideration has been given to resource requirements and costs of the intervention
edit.text: Ask applicants to estimate the population they can reach at the requested budget, state their cost assumptions and identify what a larger award could test.

findings.question: Does the call explain how proposals will be judged and which outcome definitions and reports donors can share?
findings.rationale: Outside the scope of this cost-criterion excerpt.

findings.question: Does the call fund and require reusable materials, explicit rights, access to methods and privacy protections?
findings.rationale: Outside the scope of this cost-criterion excerpt.
